screen.rationale: Mean final-epoch AUC over 3 random splits. Rejects clearly bad ideas cheaply; calibrate against a baseline-config screen run before trusting the absolute number.

loso-subset.rationale: Final-epoch AUC over the 5 largest sites. Must clear the published LOSO mean of 0.707 before spending hours on the full sweep.

loso-full.rationale: Final-epoch AUC over all 20 sites. Set above loso_cv_gcn_v1 (0.707) so only a real improvement gets promoted.
